text: The Commonwealth, the game world of Fallout 4, is a region that largely covers the former state of Massachusetts and includes Boston; its named sections include Boston, Cambridge, Concord, the Glowing Sea, Lexington, Malden, Nahant, Natick, Quincy and Salem.

label: as-reported

text: Emil Pagliarulo said in a 2009 interview that "the Commonwealth is indeed Massachusetts".

sources.title: Emil Pagliarulo, interview on 1UP (2009)
sources.quote: the Commonwealth is indeed Massachusetts.

label: as-reported

ruling.why: No tier 1 source contradicts it; Fallout 4 (2015) later set the Commonwealth in Massachusetts, so the remark was used in canon.

text: Fallout 4 opens on October 23, 2077, the day of the Great War; its main story is set in the Commonwealth in 2287, after the player character has been frozen in Vault 111 for over 200 years.

text: Boston, the former capital of Massachusetts, is part of the Commonwealth in Fallout 4; its named neighbourhoods include Back Bay, Beacon Hill, Boston Common, Boston Harbor, Charlestown, the Esplanade, the Financial District, the North End, South Boston, the Fens and the Theater District.

text: The Capital Wasteland, also called the Capital Region, is the ruins of Washington, D.C. and the surrounding area and the game world of Fallout 3; it stretches from Raven Rock in the north-west to Rivet City in the south-east.

sources.title: Grand Zealot Richter's dialogue
sources.quote: I was a soldier before I came to Atom. Lieutenant Brian Richter. Recon, Captial Region.

label: as-reported

text: Fallout 3 begins in 2277, 200 years after the Great War, when the player leaves Vault 101 for the Capital Wasteland.

sources.title: Fallout 3 official game page
sources.quote: For 200 years, Vault 101 has faithfully served the surviving residents of the Capital Wasteland.

label: as-reported

text: After the war, survivors fled the Capital Wasteland for Appalachia on trains from Union Station; Paige, who led a construction workers' union, saw toxic green air hanging over the area as they left.
label: as-reported

text: Rivet City, in the south-east of the Capital Wasteland, grew around a well-preserved science bay on a wrecked aircraft carrier that remnants of the Naval Research Institute cleared of mirelurks about 40 years before 2277.

sources.title: Horace Pinkerton's dialogue
sources.quote: remnants of the Naval Research Institute cleared the Mirelurks off this wreck about 40 years ago. We were looking for new lab-space, and this bucket of bolts just happened to have a well-preserved science bay on it.

label: as-reported

text: Joel Burgess said that in alpha the Fallout 3 world felt pushed together because the team used Oblivion's point-of-interest density, so they added a significant amount of new area to the north and west ends of the map.

sources.title: Joel Burgess, GDC 2011 talk transcript (blog)
sources.quote: We could have pared back, but we decided to add a significant amount of new area to the North and West ends of the map.

label: as-reported

ruling.why: A design statement; no tier 1 source contradicts it and the released map matches it.

text: During Fallout 3's development the downtown D.C. area was over twice its final size, with 26 enclosed areas instead of the final 12; the team cut over half the zones as too large and confusing.

sources.title: GDC 2009: Fallout 3 lead opens game design vault (GameSpot)
